QuestInfo.name: [Kin] The Third Path of the Kin
QuestInfo.0: Radiant Hua, one of the Kin, wants to give you your third assignment to become a leader of the Kin.
QuestInfo.1:
To prove that you have the skills to become a leader among Kin, you will need to collect #b10 Advanced Kinship Symbols#k. 

#rTip!#kAdvanced Kinship Symbols can be acquired from the following monsters.
-  Mystic Gate: #rKing Centipede, Master Hoblin, Master Harp, Master Birk, Kentaurus King, Chimera, Manon, Griffey, Papulatus, Riche#k
- Boss: #rZakum, Horntail#k
QuestInfo.2: You have proven to Radiant Hua that you have what it takes to be a leader of the Kin. Radiant Hua has given you the #b#t3700153##k title and a #b#t1114000##k as a reward.

0.0: Whoa, you're bursting with some much purity and joy-fire that you could be my boss! You're ready to become a Kin leader!

yes.0: All you have to do is bring me #i4033801##b #t4033801##k x10!

You can get #b#t4033802##k items from #rMystic Gates#k scattered throughout Maple World and from #rsome boss monsters#k. The monsters you need to hunt are...

- Mystic Gate: #rPianus, Leviathan, Dodo, Lilynouch, Lyka#k
- Boss: #rChaos Zakum, Chaos Horntail#k
yes.2: Got it? May love, joy, peace, and happiness be on your side! Rawr!
